mike_support: Escalating P1 -> CS. Veridian Health trial is blocked: SSO callback intermittently 500, embed dashboard times out with 504. Pilot demo in 2 hours. Please treat as renewal-risk escalation.

rachel_cs: Ack. Paste the short error output + org id and region. I'll prepare a one-paragraph comm and add an outreach plan.

mike_support: Org: veridian-health (org_vrdn_102), region: eu-west-1. Recent logs: 
```
[2026-03-23T10:14:02Z] ERROR /auth/callback 500 upstream connect failed x-request-id=cf9a21
payload: missing RelayState
```
Embed: `iframe load 504 after 28s -> https://embed.redwood.ai/v1/render?tenant=veridian-health`

devin_se: Quick triage: new edge rewrite rule is dropping RelayState on some redirect paths. Rather than full rollback we can flip the preserve-query flag for the proxy for this tenant which should restore behavior within ~5m and has lower blast radius. Patch for a permanent defensive handler is queued (~40m).

noah_pm: Good idea to avoid global rollback. Rachel lead comms — keep it concise, offer screenshare and reschedule options. I'll be on standby for exec escalate if needed. Also capture this as a renewal-signal in health.

rachel_cs: Draft outbound (short): 
"Hi Sarah 77We're investigating an authentication + embed issue that may impact today's pilot. Engineering is applying a targeted fix now. Options: (A) run the demo via screen-share at the scheduled time, or (B) reschedule. I'll update you in 10 minutes with status. Thanks, Rachel (Customer Success)"

mike_support: Support created ticket VR-2209 and opened a live bridge. bridge-bot: incident VR-2209 severity=high created.

devin_se: Plan: run `edgectl set --service edge-proxy --tenant veridian-health preserve-query=true` then purge tenant cache: `edgectl purge --tenant veridian-health`. I can execute now; expected mitigation <10m. Approve?

rachel_cs: Approve. I'll tell Sarah we're applying targeted config change and offering screenshare. Marking cs_priority=true and cs_renewal_risk=high on the org record.

devin_se: Config flip executed at +6m and purge issued. Running smoke checks. Auth callback returns 200 for sample flows, iframe render succeeds for tenant in eu-west-1.

mike_support: Support verified no 500s or 504s in last 6m. Adding mitigation note to ticket and will stand by for customer confirmation.

rachel_cs: Sent status update to Sarah at +8m. She accepted screenshare demo and appreciated the transparent note and quick fix. Scheduling 24h follow-up to capture confidence and feedback.

noah_pm: Creating product backlog item: EMB-DEF-204 - defensive RelayState handling + edge e2e for redirect query params. Tagging P0 and linking to VR-2209.

devin_se: After-action: will bake toggle into runbook and land the defensive middleware patch to remove need for toggles. Also adding an e2e to CI for redirect query preservation.

bridge-bot: VR-2209 status=mitigated assigned=devin_se.

rachel_cs: Closing this thread for now. I'll add raw customer feedback to the ticket and run the 24h check-in; will reopen if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
